tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dngos grub kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dngos grub kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dngos grub kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dngos grub kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang thob dam tshig ldan pa yi// sngags pas slob ma rjes bzung phyir// yid mthun gnas su stegs bu'i dbus// tshom bu dgus bskor de dbus su| |tshad ldan bum pa rdzas so lngas// sbags pa'i chu yis sum gnyis bkang*// mgul chings mthing nag bcas pa'i steng*// mtshan ldan thod pa sha lnga dang*// bdud rtsi lnga dang su ras bkang*// dar dmar gyis bkab me long la// sin+dhu ra yi chos 'byung dbus// hūm̐ bris bkod pa'i mtha' skor du// dpal gtor rang 'dra'i 'khor bdun bcas// dkar dmar dar gdugs spras pa dang*// sman raka mchod pas mtha' nas bskor// las bum thod rnga rdor dril sogs// nyer mkho'i yo byad 'du byas la// slob dpon bdag mdun bskyed sgrub tshul// las byang gzhung bzhin bsnyen par bya// bum nang lha bskyed mchod bstod 'bul// bsnyen zhing bzhu brtul gzhan ltar bya// tshogs 'khor bcas grub slob ma rnams// khrus byas phyag yon maṇ+ḍal dbul// dga' chen khyod sogs gsol gdab dang*// rgyun bshags rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rnams// gsum gsum grub rjes slob ma rnams// mgon po 'khor bcas gzhung bzhin bskyed// de yi gnas gsum yi ges mtshan| |slob dpon dpyid kyi rgyal mo ru/ /gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig las// 'od 'phros mgon po 'khor bcas rnams// rang rang gnas nas bu yug ltar// spyan drangs slob mar thim bsam la| |so so'i sngags mthar ā we sha// btags pas byin dbab gu gul dang*// mchog chen sha yi bdug pa bya// tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra rgya gram gyis// brtan byas slar yang bum dbang slad// byang chub rdo rje'i gsol ba gdab// slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dhū paṃ=

ā lo kaṃ= gan+dhaṃ= nai wi d+yaṃ= gyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsam/ slob dpon gyis/ hūm̐ */ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi*// skye ba thob pa'i dbang bskur ba// ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis deng*// dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa mgor bzhag bum chu blud/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams 'od kyi rnam par slob ma'i ba spu'i bu gar thim/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ des bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob rung gi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par byas so| |zhes go ba bskyed/ gsang dbang gi don du/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems dkar dmar bab pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres par bsam/ hūm̐ */ btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni// rdo rje yi ni lus 'grub par// bu khyod kyis ni shes gyis la// yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig |oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes thod pa mgrin par bzhag /bdud rtsi khar sbyin/ slob mas/ a hoḥm hā su kha/ zhes brjod/ des gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /lam steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob rung gi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par byas so// dbang gsum pa'i ched du gong ltar gsol ba gdab/

slob dpon dang ye shes mgon po'i yum las yum gnyis pa chad de/ slob ma mgon por gsal ba'i pang du byon pa la snyoms par zhugs pas bde stong gi nyams skyes par bsam/ hūm̐ */ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma// sna tshogs gzugs can yid las skyes// khyer cig dpa' chen rigs kyi bu// khyod la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// oṃ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes me long gi sin+dhu ras smin mtshams dang snying gar thig le bya/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag /lam 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob rung gi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par byas so// tshig dbang gi don du sngar ltar gsol ba gdab/ me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste| |gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin// der ni gsal dag rnyog pa med| |sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// rang bzhin med cing gnas med par// chos rnams de ltar shes nas su// sems can don ni mnyam med byos| |skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye// zhes dang don bshad/ des dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang thob/ sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi dri ma dag /zung 'jug bde stong gnyis med bsam du med pa blo bral gyi rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob rung gi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag par byas so// de nas mtha' rten gtor dbang bya ba ni/ gtor ma'i stod la mgon po rnams la/ smad 'dod yon du gsal ba slob ma'i mgor bzhag cing/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba drag po chos kyi dbyings// gtor ma'i ngo bo rdo rje srin po khro bo'i tshogs// sku yi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje snang stong dbang*// khyod la sbyin pas ye shes rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog

/oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du mgrin par bskur la/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba drag po chos kyi dbyings// gtor ma'i ngo bo rdo rje srin po khro bo'i tshogs// gsung gi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje snang stong dbang*// khyod la sbyin pas ye shes rdo rje'i gsung 'grub shog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā wāka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ snying khar bskur la/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba drag po chos kyi dbyings// gtor ma'i ngo bo rdo rje srin po khro bo'i tshogs| |thugs kyi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje gsal stong dbang*// khyod la sbyin pas ye shes rdo rje'i thugs 'grub shog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ slar spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba drag po chos kyi dbyings// gtor ma'i ngo bo rdo rje srin po khro bo'i tshogs// rnam gsum dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje zung 'jug dbang*// khyod la sbyin pas ye shes rdo rje mchog 'grub shog /oṃ badz+ra sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes bskur/ rjes su gtor ma'i bka' gtad bya ba ni/ gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs lag tu thogs te/ hoḥ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po rdo rje nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa bya rog gi mtshan can/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ rdo rje gur gyi mgon po/ lha chen stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pa/ tsan+dan gyi beng chen/ dpal mgon ma ning nag po/ mgon po stag zhon chen po/ rnam mang thos sras drag byed chen po/ so so'i yum dang las mkhan bka' sdod 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pa khyod rnams/ rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ dpal 'jigs byed chen po khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ rig pa 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde la sogs pa/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa ji bzhin du dus 'dir dran par mdzod la/

spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ chos bzhin spyod pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ dam pa'i chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings/ bye brag tu yang rnal 'byor pa bdag dang rdo rje slob ma 'di dag gi gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar gcod nad gdon dgra bgegs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang grags pa thams cad dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa dang*/ mos pa rnam pa bzhis khams gsum pa'i mi dang mi min thams cad dang gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad dbang du bsdus pa dang*/ gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal ba rnams drag pos sgrol zhing*/ bsad pa dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ rmongs pa dang*/ brdegs shing spa bkong bas tshar chod cig /mthar thug bdag dang ye shes mgon po tha dad gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rtog ge 'khrul blo'i dbang du mi 'gro bar/ rang sems ye 'dod ma'i shes pa 'khor 'das thams cad kyi dpal mgon po nyid mngon sum du rtogs nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje khrag 'thung rdo rje btsun mo dang dgyes par rol ba'i sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gar gyi cho 'phrul 'gog pa med par 'du bgyid pa'i phrin las dam pa mdzod cig /ces dang*/ rkang brgyad tshar gcig bklag /shā sa na brjod cing rol chen bya'o// slob mas dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma btang*/ rjes su mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ shis brjod/ bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// yang nad pa sogs la gtor dbang kho na bskur na/ gtor ma lhar bskyed/ mchod bstod bzlas pa bya/ slob ma khrus bya maṇ+ḍal dbul/ dga' chen khyod bdag gis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs kyis rgyun bshags bya/

slob ma mgon por bskyed/ byin dbab brtan par bya/ gtor ma'i dbang rnams gong ltar rim par bskur zhing*/ sngar dbang bzhi'i skabs kyi dag pa rnams gtor dbang so sor sbyar la brjod/ dam tshig khas blangs/ gtang rag dbul/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ shis brjod/ bsngo bas rgyas btab pas don 'grub par 'gyur ro// smras pa/ thub bstan srung mdzad nag po 'khor bcas kyi// dbang bzhi byin rlabs tshul du bskur ba 'di// tshul ldan slob ma'i rgyud la bskyed rdzogs kyi// snod rung smin lam rten 'brel nges par 'jog |tshul min rnams la dbang bzhi'i cho ga ni// shin tu rgyas pa lan stong bskur na yang*// kha sbub snod steng gaṅgā drangs dang mtshungs// de ltar dpal ye shes mgon po brgyad kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dngos gru+ub kyi dga' ston zhes pa 'di'ang*/ rang re'i chos sras blo gros kyi mig stong bkra ba mnga' ris pa 'on rin chen brag gi gdan sa ba dkon mchog lhun grub kyis nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ shing lug smin drug can gyi dkar po'i dga' ba dang por/ dpal 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen po byang chub gling gi khang gsar 'og min gyi gtsug lag khang chen por mgyogs par bris pa'o/// /sid+dhi rastu//
